payload.title: Working with Age Ensembles
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates handling age ensembles in paleoclimate studies, focusing on quantifying chronological uncertainties using the PyLiPD package. It covers creating EnsembleSeries objects, exporting ensemble data to Numpy arrays and Pandas DataFrames, and provides examples using data from LiPD and NOAA.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and set up the environment for the notebook.
steps.title: Setup and Imports

steps.description: Load and process data from a LiPD file using the PyLiPD package. Extract ensemble tables and paleo data into dataframes.
steps.title: Load Data from LiPD

steps.description: Export ensemble information from LiPD files to Numpy arrays and Pandas DataFrames for further analysis.
steps.title: Export Ensemble Information

steps.description: Load and process ensemble data from NOAA using URLs. Handle missing values and prepare data for analysis.
steps.title: Load Data from NOAA

steps.description: Create an EnsembleGeoSeries object to represent uncertainty in paleo data using variations in the value axis.
steps.title: Create Ensemble Series
